entries.4469298ad22f56a4: This division selects optimal equipment for systems and sells it to cable television operators, telecommunications carriers and ISPs. It handles equipment developed and manufactured in-house as well as products of other companies, including overseas products, and after thorough verification of specifications and compatibility with systems, it also performs customization incorporating proprietary technology developed in-house as needed. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥5,014 million.
entries.6509f086d2a1e4c7: A system integration company for cable television operators, handling everything from the design and construction of broadcasting and communication systems to equipment sales, operation, and maintenance.
entries.87821e1ffc76f177: This is the single segment of the group.
